title: The Temple Theme Kit is pickable: thirteen profile kits on the design's Home, and a place in every theme list, as the Network Theme Kit has
detail: Pass 5 of the Temple Theme Kit (code id temple-kit, shown as Temple), mirroring the Network Theme Kit's registration. temple-kit joins SITE_THEME_DEFS and MEGA_THEMES, the editor's WEBSITE_THEMES, EDITOR_THEME_OF, the library (served at /themes/temple, /themes/temple-kit redirects), the wizard, the picker's calm feel, MEGA_SURFACES and the Spotlight presets. The earlier temple theme (Royal Temple's) keeps its id, stored site styles, skin and loaders so the live site renders as before, and leaves every owner-facing list (RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS, the library, the wizard, the Spotlight presets and the editor's kit list). The thirteen profile kits (temple-kit-<niche>, lib/sites/kits/temple-kit-profile-variants.ts) are the design's Home block for block (templeKitHomeBlocks) after a starter copy pass (no price, seat count, rating, discount, rhythm or free promise), with four short pages for the Home's buttons; they differ by accent only (templeKitProfileAccent). TempleKit stays out of WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE, so the public site and the member area do not serve it yet. The inner pages (LIVE-1684 and the groups after it) register in a later change.

verify.evidence: temple-kit is offered and the earlier temple is not; thirteen kits load, each the design's Home; library, wizard and editor list the kit.
